subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should the doctor auth migration preserve full canonical credential fields, including SecretRefs and OAuth refresh metadata, from legacy `auth.json` and flat `auth-profiles.json` into SQLite?
rationale: The code-level fix is narrow and proven, but it changes how sensitive credential metadata is carried across an upgrade, which is an owner/security-boundary acceptance decision.

options.title: Land focused preservation
options.body: Accept the upgrade contract that canonical credential fields should survive doctor migration and merge this PR after owner review.

options.title: Add broader shipped-shape coverage
options.body: Ask for one more regression fixture based on a confirmed shipped legacy auth shape before merging.

options.title: Coordinate with adjacent flat-store work
options.body: Pause only if maintainers want this field-preservation fix bundled with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245.

recommendation.title: Land focused preservation
recommendation.body: Accept the upgrade contract that canonical credential fields should survive doctor migration and merge this PR after owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-profile migration history and central files point to this owner path for the migration contract decision.
